scope: every cell that clears PREFILL_GATE 0.80 across all 29 page directories
read: 2026-08-13, and again after the banner fix
how: each cell rendered as strip + context with the row band ticked off, in out/audit/tiles, and counted by eye at 3x-8x; the context is what settles whether a mark belongs to this row
note: `count` is what a person reads off the card, not what a spreadsheet says. Where the two differ the spreadsheet is the one that is wrong -- see moonlight-7.05:33:27, oceanbeach-9.06:31:31, seaport-6.13:5:39 and 5:40. The four delmar/moonlight/seaport cells at the top were admitted by the banner fix and read afterwards. Three more were added on 20 Aug 2026: they were surfaced by an experiment that required a printed rule to be inked on BOTH sides of the row band, which was then reverted (see HANDOFF). The counts are facts about the cards and stand regardless -- imperial-6.06:6:53 is one stroke, the mark at the far right runs past the band and is the printed border; moonlight-7.05:19:31 is four, the fifth stroke sits below the band and belongs to the next row; pacific-9.27:22:75 is ONE, read at 7x -- a single curved stroke with a faint pressure trail to its lower left, which the counter read as two.

wrong_when_last_run.pacific-9.27:14:26: said 3, is 4. Four strokes, two of which hang below the row band. An undercount, not a false positive, and the only one of its kind here.
